newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to crack down on barter deals - dep minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to crack down on barter deals - dep minister.

text.p: Ukraine's government will attempt to reduce barter deals by five percent each quarter through a new decree being prepared for President Leonid Kuchma, the deputy economy minister said on Wednesday.
"We want, partly through administrative measures and partly through economic measures, to start reducing the amount of bartering taking place," Anatoly Danylenko told a news conference.
State-run enterprises, which barter the most, often trade items like fuel and materials.
Danylenko said those not meeting targets established in the decree, due to come into effect on April 1, will be fined.

Danylenko did not have figures on the amount of bartering taking place, but said levels were "very high" and were responsible for enterprise and budgetary debts, and were used as a way to avoid paying taxes.
